prompt:
Locked-off camera, late at night on a wet, empty Midtown corner. Inside the open steel phone box the woman in the camel cardigan lifts the ringing receiver the last few inches to her ear, listens, and her wary look slowly turns to quiet astonishment; she straightens up, nods once, very composed, as if told something important, and keeps listening. Her free hand stays flat on the little steel shelf beside the paper cup. She never leaves the box. One car's lights slide past far behind. Movement continues to the last frame. Sound: a quiet wet street at night. No music, no dialogue.

Thanks.
